spells.notes: 전두환-era holdover. The whole 김정렬 cabinet submitted resignations on 1988-02-24 and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25 before giving the new cabinet its 임명장 that morning, so he was in office for part of 1988-02-25 and the handover to 윤근환 was same-day. The mafra page prints 1988.02.24 (its day-before convention). As to the start, the 개각 was announced on the afternoon of 1987-05-18 (chronology and 매일경제 date the appointment to the 18th) and the 임명장 was given on the morning of 1987-05-19, which is also the mafra date. Birth date and hanja from ko.wikipedia '김주호 (1933년)' revid 41473557 (https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41473557, snapshot roster/sources/agriculture/ext88/wiki/wiki_person_김주호_(1933년).json, accessed 2026-09-26T09:24:47-0400). The hanja are also printed in the 1987-05-20 조선일보 story.

issues.desc: Start-date convention for reshuffles announced before the 임명장. Pre-2001 there is no gazette file, and the news usually reports a reshuffle as 임명 on the day it was announced while the 임명장 was given one or two days later. This file sets start to the 임명장 day, which is also the day the tier-2 ministry pages print in most of these cases and the convention the main roster used for 이효계 (1997-08-06). Split cases in this lineage, announcement -> 임명장: 김주호 1987-05-18 -> 05-19, 강보성 1990-03-17 -> 03-19, 강현욱 1992-03-30 -> 03-31, 김양배 1993-12-21 -> 12-22, 최인기 1994-04-04 -> 04-06, 강운태 1995-12-20 -> 12-21, 이효계 1997-08-05 -> 08-06 (main record). Each has start_confidence 'medium' and the announcement day is the nomination_date. One contemporary report supports the 임명장 reading (동아일보 1993-12-22 on the new 부총리 still describing himself by his old post because he had not yet received the 임명장), and one uses '임명 발령' on the announcement day (국민일보 1990-03-17 for 법제처장). Other lineages should use the same rule. A cross-lineage note on the main roster follows. justice.verified.json starts 김종구 on 1997-08-05, while 서울신문 1997-08-07 (BigKinds 01100611.20160421115451026) reports that he received the 임명장 with the other 8·5 appointees on the morning of 1997-08-06, the date the agriculture main record uses for 이효계.

The mafra 역대장관 list (tier 2) disagrees with the day-of news in several rows, so it was not used alone for any date. 김식 start printed 1988.12.06 (임명장 1988-12-05 afternoon). 강보성 start printed 1990.03.20 (임명장 and 취임식 1990-03-19). 김양배 row printed '1993.12.22 ~ 1993.12.21' (dismissed 1994-04-04, ko.wikipedia 1994-04-04). 강운태 is a single row '1995.12.21 ~ 1996.12.21' spanning the 1996-08-08 renaming, and 정시채 start is printed 1996.12.21, the day of his 취임식 (임명장 1996-12-20 afternoon). End dates on the page otherwise follow a day-before-successor convention (김주호 1988.02.24, 조경식 1992.03.30, 강현욱 1993.02.25, 최인기 1995.12.20, 정시채 1997.08.05) that this file converts to the last day in office.

1988-02-25 transition. The 김정렬 cabinet submitted resignations on 1988-02-24 and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25, before giving the new cabinet the 임명장 that morning (조선일보 1988-02-26, 매일경제 1988-02-25, 중앙일보 1988-02-25). 김주호 therefore ends on 1988-02-25 and is included as a 전두환-era holdover with one day in the window. The mafra page ends him on 1988.02.24. Other lineages should end their 5공 holdovers the same way.

Vacancy 1994-04-05..1994-04-05 (1 day) between 김양배 (해임 and 이임식 on the afternoon of 1994-04-04) and 최인기 (임명장 on the morning of 1994-04-06). The acting record for the sitting 차관 김태수 is inferred (he is documented as 차관 on 1994-01-12, 1994-03-22 and again on 1994-04-12, and no source names an acting minister).
